body:
## What it does

Starts from a concrete job rather than a general improvement, then works through whether the connectors and standing instructions actually support it. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @GuleidAmina shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
